newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures close mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures close mostly lower.

text.p: May 2 - IMM currency futures closed mostly lower, with Can dollars sustaining the bulk of the day's gains. June sterling continued to trim losses above the $1.62 level, while marks and Swiss francs remained lower. White House and Republicans announced they reached a balanced budget deal. (Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))

At the end of pit trade, June yen was up $0.000003 at $0.007949, marks were down $0.0023 at $0.5801, Swiss francs fell $0.0008 at $0.6827, sterling was off $0.0024 at $1.6202, Canadian dollars were up $0.0025 at $0.7258, Australian dollars were off $0.0011 at $0.7831 and Mexican pesos were $0.000600 at $0.124375.
